usedFor: A person who books a time in 42min gets registered for the Zoom webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in 42min, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: The trigger is pushed, so the booker is registered the moment they pick a time.

watchOut: “Updated Booking Time” also runs this action, so a reschedule could register the same person twice.
